sections.title: MT
sections.text: TRAILING SFC FRONT THAT WILL DRAPE ITSELF ALONG THE MT/WY BORDER WILL ENHANCE CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SRN MT BY LATE AFTERNOON. STRONG HEATING BENEATH A BELT OF 35-40KT FLOW AT 500MB SHOULD PROVE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WITHIN AN OTHERWISE WEAKLY FORCED REGIME. NEUTRAL-WEAK HEIGHT RISES ACROSS THIS REGION SUGGEST ACTIVITY WILL REMAIN ISOLATED BUT CONVECTION COULD POSE A RISK FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS AS STORMS PROPAGATE EWD AT ROUGHLY 30KT TOWARD A MORE FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT OVER THE PLAINS OF CNTRL/SERN MT.

sections.title: GULF STATES
sections.text: WEAK MID LEVEL CIRCULATION OVER SRN AL/FL PANHANDLE WILL MOVE LITTLE DURING THE PERIOD. NUMEROUS SHOWERS/THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS THE GULF STATES INVOF THIS FEATURE THE LAST FEW DAYS AND FRIDAY SHOULD BE NO DIFFERENT. MID LEVEL FLOW APPEARS JUST STRONG ENOUGH TO WARRANT PULSE-MULTICELL UPDRAFTS THAT COULD PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG DOWNBURSTS DURING THE HEAT OF THE DAY. ..DARROW/HURLBUT.. 07/15/2011
